G. Viswanathan, founder and Chancellor, VIT, invite Vice-President of India C.P. Radhakrishnan for an Asian University Presidents Forum meet. | Photo Credit: Special Arrangement
The Vice-President of India C.P. Radhakrishnan was invited to attend a meeting of the Asian University Presidents Forum that will be held at VIT campus in Vellore.
According to a press release, G. Viswanathan, founder and Chancellor, VIT, met Mr. Radhakrishnan in New Delhi in the presence of Sekar Viswanathan, vice-president, VIT. The VIT Chancellor invited Mr. Radhakrishnan to attend the meeting, the release said.
